description: She wears a floor-length dark blue gown with a square neckline, fitted bodice and elbow-length sleeves, richly trimmed in gold floral and geometric embroidery at the neckline, shoulders, cuffs, central front and hem. Round gold shoulder brooches and a decorated narrow belt with a round clasp accent the dress. A cream underdress is visible at the sleeve ends and lower front. A pale grey-beige wrap with broad blue-and-gold embroidered borders and fine fringe drapes around both arms. A small round gold pendant and dark closed shoes are visible.
